tool_architecture.primary_function: Dynamic CV Builder bypassing ERP portal restrictions
tool_architecture.description: The official ERP portal restricts CV modification, activating the CV-building module only during highly specific pre-internship and pre-placement windows. Dynac solves the problem of space management and the repeated necessity of updating the CV on the ERP just to view rendering changes. Effectively provides students with a CI/CD pipeline for their resumes.
tool_architecture.deployment_methodology: Local installation with ERP authentication bypass

operational_mechanics.core_problem_solved: ERP CV-building module only available during narrow pre-placement windows
key_features: Continuous CV rendering without ERP window restrictions
Space management optimization for constrained ERP CV format
Dynamic resume updates based on real-time company intelligence
Bypass static constraints imposed by administration
operational_mechanics.strategic_advantage: Candidates can micro-optimize their resumes dynamically based on real-time intelligence gathered about specific visiting companies

dependencies.name: iitkgp-erp-login-go
dependencies.description: Provides automated authentication bypassing, acting as the foundational dependency for multiple downstream MetaKGP applications

compliance_and_risk_warnings: Depends on iitkgp-erp-login-go for authentication circumvention
Use may violate institutional ERP terms of service
